title: Toss & Catch Set – 4 Baskets and Balls on a Cord
descriptionHtml:
Kubb season is two weekends long

Lawn games need flat ground, lots of players and an hour of setup. The rest of the summer they sit in the shed.

The game that's up and running in thirty seconds

Four baskets with a strap – one in your hand or around your neck – and balls on 84 cm cord. Throw, catch in the basket, switch sides. Works on the lawn, the beach and the campsite, two players or the whole group.

Features

  • Up and running in thirty seconds – no field to chalk, nothing to screw together
  • Everyone can join in right away – catching in a basket is easier than catching by hand
  • Four baskets in the set – two matches at once or the whole family in a circle
  • The ball doesn't get lost – the cord is attached to the basket, no searching in the flower bed

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
